grafana.note: Default Grafana administrator login and data-source proxy use. Chainstack says no software vulnerability was exploited.

mcp-exec.note: The MCP server's service account already had cluster-admin. Individual tool calls were not recovered.

prod-secrets.note: Production secrets-manager bulk reads, Kubernetes secret lists, and the node cloud token. Development credentials were valid in production.

persist.note: Cron launched Chisel and the artx-guard systemd timer beaconed. This is the persistence write, not the tunnel protocol.
